description_en: This operation updates the metadata of a table
description_zh: 该接口用于更新表的Meta信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-meta-table --project-id 101 --table-name table1 --env-type 1 --table-guid odps.test.table1 --new-owner-id 12345 --added-labels a,b,c --removed-labels a,b,c --category-id 101 --visibility 1 --caption '中文名' --schema default --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMetaTable

parameters.help_en: The environment of the DataWorks workspace. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates the development environment. The value 1 indicates the production environment
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks的环境，包括0（开发环境）和1（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The GUID of the table. Specify the GUID in the format of odps.{projectName}.{tableName}
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The new owner ID. If you leave this parameter empty, the owner ID is not updated
parameters.name: new_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the labels that you want to add. Separate the labels with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要增加的标签名称，使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: added_labels

parameters.help_en: The names of labels that you want to remove. Separate the labels with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的标签名称，使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: removed_labels

parameters.help_en: The ID of the category that you want to associate
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The scope in which the table is visible. Valid values: 0, 1, and 2. The value 0 indicates that the table is invisible to all members. The value 1 indicates that the table is visible to all members. The value 2 indicates that the table is visible to workspace members
parameters.help_zh: 编辑表的可见性，包括0（不可见）、1（可见）和2（工作空间可见）
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The display name of the table
parameters.name: caption

parameters.help_en: The schema information about the table. You must configure this parameter if you enable the three-layer model of MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh: 表Schema信息。在ODPS，用户启动了三层模型需要填写Schema信息
parameters.name: schema

UpdateResult.description_en: Indicates whether the metadata information about the table was updated
